summary: Ryanair furnished a Form 6-K on 5 October 2026 disclosing that ENAA, a lobbying group led by Lufthansa and Air France/KLM and their subsidiaries, filed a High Court action in Ireland seeking to suspend Ryanair's air operating licence by invoking EU ownership and control rules. Ryanair states it fully complies with EU ownership and control requirements and will vigorously oppose the contrived claim, which it says is an attempt to restrict competition and choice in EU air travel. No deal terms, financial consideration, board recommendation or advisors were disclosed. Watch for court timetable and licence-suspension risk.
